publishedRecipe.name: Basil Pesto Pasta with Chicken, Roasted Asparagus, Zucchini & Tomato

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
2 medium zucchini squash
2 pints grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch pieces. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and medium dice zucchini. Add to the baking sheet with the asparagus.
Halve tomatoes and add to the baking sheet.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and large dice. Add to the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle veggies and chicken with oil, then season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and return to the pot. Cover and set aside to keep warm.
When the veggies and chicken are done, carefully transfer them to the pot with the pasta. Add the pesto and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and enjoy!
